name: Valentinian III
title: Placidus Valentinianus
summary: Valentinian III was Roman emperor in the West from 425 to 455. Starting in childhood, his reign over the Roman Empire was one of the longest, but was dominated by civil wars among powerful generals and the barbarian invasions. He was the youngest sole emperor in the Western Roman Empire.
notes: Reign: 29 years, 4 months and 21 days. Valentinian was a weak emperor whose reign saw the loss of Africa to the Vandals and increasing barbarian influence. The de facto date of the Western Empire's fall is often placed in his era. | Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Valentinian_III
